notes.title: My new game coming soon: Strategy game but with a penguin who has a sword
notes.content:
It's been about one and half years since I released my last game, and now I can finally announce my next game!

Strategy game but with a penguin who has a sword

It's a relaxing strategy / tactics rougelite game with lofi hiphop music. And there is a penguin. <(")

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37712971/8934dd1e8127a028c5e9c22982cc2dad6fd44619.gif

Some features

 Turn-based strategy
 Both hand-designed and infinite randomized rooms
 Good lofi hiphop music
 The penguin can be customized :)
 Ideal to play while listening to something


Maybe add it to your wishlist?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2423780/

notes.title: Unknown Castle Version 2.0.1
notes.content:
This update has many bug fixes.


     Bug fix: In the Steam version when moving the player, the mouse moved randomly preventing the menu from hiding
     Bug fix: When using controller the menu didn’t hide
     Bug fix: When using menu with controller it was possible to accidentally use a level door
     Changed a windows pop up to the game’s own pop up in the treasure room when using multiplayer
     The game window can be resized again

notes.title: Version 2.0.0 - Widescreen support and other stuff
notes.content:
Unknown Castle was updated to version 2.0.0!

Widescreen support
Because of the size of the game rooms, in fullscreen the sides of the screen were always black. But now there is optional widescreen support! You can use F9 to enable it. However, it might not be the best choice if you are playing in multiplayer.

Before:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35155445/e08d5416e05799470d46231d379c112cf97f7469.png

After:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35155445/8b5f84295badf817afa89aae32a6d4ed7d62ad95.png

Some of the menus were edited so that they work better in widescreen.

New cool mouse cursor
Added a different image (sprite) for mouse (Press F8 if you want to disable it)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35155445/2ff77b65526fc3fee744a647fcfd8e5e1927f8fd.png

Bug fixes and other improvements
- Now the player or enemies can't move when there is a pop up question
- When pressing "No" in pop up question in the menu it could accidentally press also some menu button. Now it's fixed.
- Other small improvements
- Thanks to improved code and an update in game engine, the download size of the game is slightly smaller

Sale
There is also a sale now (or soon?), so it’s a good chance to start exploring this unknown castle!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1090650/Unknown_Castle/

notes.title: New Supper Banana! released on Steam
notes.content:
New Supper Banana! released!

New Supper Banana! is now available for PC, on Steam and itchio!

Here is a trailer: https://youtu.be/lTNvBB8fqno

New Supper Banana! is a funny adventure platformer drawn entirely in a notebook!

Story

The mad eater has appeared from another dimension and is eating everyone. You have to save them!

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37712971/140560936d399d25fc7071b7e13be872a2757b10.gif

Gameplay

It's a 2D platformer game with an unique ability: Supper Dash!

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37712971/af5dbe4a1c83cb2e4e2c9599a9af30dddfb90b71.gif

Features


         10 Levels
         Actually hand-drawn graphics
         A funny story
         Customizable difficulty: You can choose the amount of hearts you have


Get it now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1681080/New_Supper_Banana/

notes.title: Full controller support
notes.content:
Unknown Castle update version 1.9.5

In this update controller support was improved and there are some other fixes.

The changes: 

 Better controller support
 Main menu and pop-up questions can be used with keyboard and controller now
 Settings can be used with controller now (using shoulder buttons)
 Resetting game question changed from windows pop-up dialog to the game's own pop-up dialog
 Improved slightly some translations

notes.title: Update version 1.9.4
notes.content:
Unknown Castle Version 1.9.4

This update is mostly bug fixes. Here are the changes: 

Space can be now used for dialogue & interacting sometimes
Fixed bug where the in singleplayer the other character turned when the other was moved
Fixed bug where the player jumped up and got stuck in the wall when pressing up when in stairs and on a moving platform

notes.title: Update: controller support & more
notes.content:
Hello!
Unknown Castle has a new update!

New on version 1.9.3: 
- Partial controller support. Mouse is needed in some things in the menu and there are no instructions for gamepad controls. But the controls are very intuitive.
- Credits now redirect to main menu automatically
- Game window can now be resized and fullscreen button is now enabled (you can still use F11 for fullscreen)
- Fixed a little bug
- Improved performance
- Improved & organized code


Also, if you don't know about my new game, Dr. Atominus, check it out. = )
